_rule: Start from the arms base. Set lr to the value in {3e-4, 1e-3 (base_heldout), 3e-3} with the lowest final held-out loss. Add the one change among warmup15, clip3, wd0.1, attn_dropout0.1 whose final held-out loss beat base_heldout by more than the noise margin (PLAN.md); if none did, add none, and if the best lr is 1e-3 with no winning change, skip this trial.
